fixture.kickoff_timezone_provenance: PremierLeague.com official fixture identity previously captured in R39R/R39S; UTC conversion from 20:00 BST

market_source.independence_rule: Treat the whole page as one provider group. Listed bookmakers are not counted as independent markets in R44A.

purpose: Bootstrap an auditable V5.2 forward-PIT evidence path using an official Premier League lineup page plus one public odds-aggregator provider group. Stage 1 discovers/captures source pages and records first-observed timestamps and hashes; it does not create a formal market snapshot or predictive claim.

stage1_success_semantics.PASS_R44A_SOURCE_FEASIBILITY_NOT_FORMAL_: Official lineup state is captured pre-kickoff and a single public aggregator page for the same fixture visibly exposes H/D/A, Asian and at least four half-goal OU lines plus price-like values. Exact structured prices are intentionally not yet admitted.
stage1_success_semantics.STOP_R44A_MARKET_DISCOVERY_NO_MATCH: Official lineup evidence may be valid, but no qualifying market page was discovered inside the frozen request budget. Stop before any label/model work.
